steps.code:
# Now let's import all markdown files to Simple Note.
# For each file, read content, derive title from filename, and create a note.
sn_access_token = sn_login['access_token']
created_notes = []
for file_path in files:
    # Read file content
    file_data = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=file_path)
    content = file_data['content']
    # Derive title: basename without .md, replace underscores with spaces
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]  # e.g., "Book_Reading_Lists.md"
    title = filename[:-3]  # remove ".md"
    title = title.replace('_', ' ')
    # Create note in Simple Note
    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(title=title, content=content, access_token=sn_access_token)
    created_notes.append((title, result))
    print(f"Created note: {title} -> {result}")
